content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is under the DST-PURSE Programme of the University of Calicut, with Dr. Abraham Joseph, Senior Professor, Department of Chemistry, as the coordinator. The project is titled "Harvesting Renewable Energy for a Sustainable Future Explorations on Designer Molecules and Functional Materials". The post is purely temporary.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy is in the Open Competition (OC) category. The notice gives the age limit as 35*, with age relaxation as per DST, Govt. of India norms. It prints no date for counting age. Qualification in CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or selection through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments, Agencies, or Institutions. Demonstrated research experience in one or more of: nanomaterials; electrocatalysis/photocatalysis; energy-related applications; atomically precise nanoclusters. Because the position is tenable for one year, the notice says preference may be given to candidates with relevant research experience and demonstrated expertise in these areas. Hands-on research experience directly relevant to the project may be given due consideration in selection, in addition to the national-level qualifications. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in chemistry (or relevant discipline) from a recognized university or equivalent, with 2 years research experience in relevant field
rows.desirable: CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or selection through national-level examinations; demonstrated research experience in the listed areas

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship/remuneration is ₹35000+HRA. The duration of the project/selection is till 29.11.2027 or completion of the project, whichever earlier. The notice states that the Project Associate should work full-time on the project and should not get any salary from other sources. If suitable candidates are not available for the Project Associate II category, the post will be treated as Project Associate I. The selected Project Associate has the option of registering for the PhD program under the guidance of the project team members as per prevailing University regulations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UOC Project Associate II
content_sections.text: Prepare your biodata with your email ID, and copies of relevant certificates. Send them by email to the coordinator at [email protected] . Write the subject as "Application for the DST PURSE project". Send the email on or before 20-11-2026. Biodata, along with email ID Copies of relevant certificates For more details, the notice names Dr. Abraham Joseph, Senior Professor, Department of Chemistry, University of Calicut, Malappuram District 673 635. His email is [email protected] , and his phone number is 9447650334.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on performance in a written test and a subsequent personal interview. Only short-listed candidates will be intimated through email, and they will have to attend the written test and interview. The notice does not give the test or interview date or venue.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the test and interview. Selected candidates have to join immediately. The post is purely temporary.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate II posts has the University of Calicut announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 Project Associate II post in the DST-PURSE project, in the Open Competition (OC) category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for UOC Project Associate II?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 20-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for UOC Project Associate II?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in chemistry (or relevant discipline) from a recognized university or equivalent, with 2 years research experience in the relevant field. CSIR-UGC NET/GATE is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for UOC Project Associate II?
faq.answer: The notice prints the age limit as 35*, with age relaxation as per DST, Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of UOC Project Associate II?
faq.answer: The fellowship/remuneration is ₹35000+HRA, as printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for UOC Project Associate II?
faq.answer: Email your biodata with email ID and copies of relevant certificates to [email protected], with the subject "Application for the DST PURSE project".

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in a written test and a subsequent personal interview. Only short-listed candidates are informed by email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the UOC Project Associate II job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the post is purely temporary, till 29.11.2027 or completion of the project, whichever earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the test and interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be paid to candidates for attending the test and interview.

faq.answer: Yes, the selected Project Associate has the option of registering for the PhD program under the guidance of the project team members, as per prevailing University regulations.
